rationale: The gap-and-fade thesis remains intact — price is below session VWAP ($54.11), hugging the 9-EMA after a ~5% markdown from the open on 5x relative volume, with no reversal structure or bounce catalyst in the recent 1m bars. Reward to the $52.65 target (~$0.96) still slightly exceeds risk to the $54.42 invalidation (~$0.81), and the wide 24.2 bps spread argues against paying to churn the position. A flip to long would require a VWAP reclaim and higher lows, neither of which is present, so I maintain the short.
